ammo_mg_rocket.note: two bytes, machine gun and rocket ammo (order unknown); 0x6363 under cheat bit 0x2

ammo_pistol.note: pistol ammo (byte); 99 under cheat bit 0x2; CodeBreaker 8002C450 6300

armor.note: armor; 0 at start, 3 under all-weapons cheat bit 0x2

bonus_mult.note: bonus multiplier; 1 at start, 5 under cheat bit 0x20

cheat_flags.note: cheat bitmask, read at level load (writing it mid-level freezes play on the brief). Verified by booting with each bit: 0x1 99 lives, 0x2 weapons+ammo+armor+key, 0x4 score 9999990, 0x8 coords in district banner, 0x10 max wanted, 0x20 5x bonus, 0x40-0x400 unlock levels progressively, 0x800 all levels, 0x2000 no cops (unverified effect)

ctrl_x.note: world x of whatever the player controls (on foot or the car), integer units; derived (writes don't stick). Unlike player_x, it keeps updating while driving

ctrl_y.note: world y of whatever the player controls; see ctrl_x

jobs_done.note: candidate job-completion counter: 0 -> 1 on delivering job 1, unchanged by accepting, death or a later failed job. Only one completion observed

lives.note: lives; 4 at start; 4->3 on a real death; 99 under cheat bit 0x1

mission_stage.note: mission phase byte, not monotonic. Job 1: 4 no job, 3 accepted, 2 in Jimmy's car (+5000), 3 after delivery (+20000, timed follow-up offered), 2 after that follow-up timed out. Survives death

no_job.note: 1 before any job, 0 once one is accepted; stayed 0 through delivery and the failed follow-up

wanted.note: wanted level 0-4 (HUD police heads); 4 under max-wanted cheat bit; writing it sets the HUD (0x80019FE4 follows); natural rise from crime not yet observed
